text.p: Atlantic Coast Airlines Inc and Bombardier Inc said on Tuesday Atlantic Coast signed a deal to buy 12 Canadair Regional Jet Series 200 ER aircraft from Bombardier Regional Aircraft Division.
The contract also optioned another 36 jets for the airline.
The companies said the contract is worth more than US$240 million (C$321.9 million) for the 12 firm aircraft orders.
Deliveries are set to begin in July this year and continue through September 1998. Atlantic Coast will inaugurate Canadair Jet service in September this year.
Atlantic Coast now has 57 19- and 29-seat aircraft which fly to 39 cities in 17 U.S. states.
The Atlantic Coast order brings Bombardier's Canadair Regional Jet orderbook to 200 aircraft of which 143 have been delivered and 57 are on firm order backlog, the companies said.
